title: neltuma velutina
intro: Neltuma velutina, commonly known as the Velvet Pod, is a plant species that belongs to the family Annonaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and skin problems. The health benefits of Neltuma velutina include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it an effective remedy for wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antiseptic, and antipyretic effects.
